name: Port Kill
author: jesusarchive
description: Find and free development ports from the Omarchy bar with Port Kill.

barWidget.description: View processes on ports 2000 through 9000 and stop them individually or all at once.

schema.label: When to monitor
schema.description: Follow terminal shows the icon while a registered terminal monitor runs. Always active starts monitoring when enabled and keeps running without a terminal, until you choose Quit.

schema.label: Check interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to check listening sockets while monitoring is active. Does not change the terminal monitor interval.
